PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 135 ("MCA-135") - ADOPTION OF ZONING REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO LARGE FAMILY DAYCARE HOMES WITHIN THE RESIDENTIAL ZONES OF THE CITY
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council:
1) Approve and adopt the Negative Declaration;
2) Waive reading of Ordinance and read by title only; and
3) Introduce Ordinance - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente adding Sections 10.08.900, 10.08.910 and 10.16.010(n) to Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code Pertaining to Zoning Regulations of Large Family Daycare Homes in the Residential Zones of the City (Municipal Code Amendment No. 135)

D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
D-6
AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT WITH ARMIJO NEWSPAPERS & PUBLIC RELATIONS, LLC (NOW ABC PR LLC) AND GRANTING OF ADDITIONAL ONE YEAR-EXTENSION TO THE AGREEMENT FOR PRODUCTION AND DISTRIBUTION OF QUARTERLY NEWSLETTER
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council:
1) Approve the amendment to the agreement with ABC PR LLC for Spotlight La Puente consultant services and authorize the Interim City Manager to execute the agreement, subject to review and approval by the Interim City Attorney as to form; and
2) Approve the option of an additional one-year extension with ABC PR LLC for production and distribution of the quarterly Spotlight La Puente newsletter, with the term of the agreement ending on February 1, 2012, and the option of one additional extension though February 1, 2013, executed in writing in the form of a letter by the City, if the City so chooses, with or without modifications to the payment rate, levels of services, type of service, and any other factors which the City may deem necessary to meet its purposes, through negotiation with the Consultant.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENTS TO: PLANNING COMMISSION, PUENTE PRIDE COMMITTEE AND EDUCATION COMMISSION
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council make appointments to fill scheduled vacancies to subject commissions and committees.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF THE DISPOSAL OF CITY SURPLUS EQUIPMENT
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to hire an auction company to dispose of the item listed in Attachment A.
E-3
RECOMMENDED USES OF DESIGNATED FUND BALANCE FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS AND ONE-TIME RESERVES
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Resolution amending the 2010-11 General Fund budget.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WITH JOSI KENLINE
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Settlement Agreement.
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Community Development Commission, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Community Development Commission. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
